criterion_text: Standalone and Server-connected Agents accept their own `agent_token` for inbound WS and embedded MCP, including Agent restart persistence and explicit operator override; Agent `auth_token` remains outbound Server credential only, empty/malformed secrets fail closed and rotation cannot keep authorizing a newly connected peer using the old value.

verifiers.summary: Standalone and connected Agents use their own durable token for inbound WS and MCP; provisioning persists, rotation is a restart, and malformed values fail closed

evidence.value: exact target SHA stack: standalone WS and MCP accepted the Agent Token and refused the Server Token; rotation accepted the new value and refused the old; an unset token was generated at mode 0600 and reused after restart; a malformed value failed the start
crates/nession-agent/src/token.rs owns provisioning/persistence; crates/nession-agent/src/p2p_auth.rs and server/mcp.rs verify the same endpoint token
